title: valeriana jepsonii
intro: Valeriana jepsonii, commonly known as Jepson's valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It is native to California in the United States. The health benefits of Jepson's valerian include its use as a sedative and anxiolytic, promoting relaxation and reducing stress and anxiety levels. The bioactive constituents of Jepson's valerian include valerenic acid, isovalerenol, and valeranone, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects.
